The problem

Yoga videos can’t see you. Nobody tells you when your knee drifts or your back rounds.

What it does

Yoginini is a yoga teacher on your phone that watches your pose and gives one calm correction at a time.

How it works

  1. Follows 33 points on your body through the phone camera
  2. Speaks one correction at a time, like a teacher across the room
  3. Video never leaves your phone. Book a real teacher by the hour when you want one

Free to join the waitlist.

Private-lesson feedback without booking a private lesson.

TodayBeing built. The site and the waitlist are open; the app is not out yet.

The film

Aims

Autonomous operation
The teacher on the phone runs itself; the real teachers are people and stay that way. Agents run bookings, payouts, support, the coach cohort and the teaching content around them.
Intelligence
Perception on the device: a pose model tracking 33 landmarks, angle and score models that never see video, and a voice that chooses one correction at a time. The backend’s intelligence is scheduling and matching, not vision.
Growth
Practice-led. Growth is people who practise every week and the hours booked with real teachers, counted from the first app in hands.
The technical detail

A yoga teacher that can see you. A pose model running on the phone tracks 33 body landmarks and speaks one calm correction at a time, and no video ever leaves the device. Real teachers are bookable by the hour alongside it. The site and the waitlist are open; the app is not built.
